request.notes: Argos Bot provides an x402-payable CTS Bridge API for Arc and Base token lookups, ownerless wrapper creation, and resumable bridge jobs using Circle CTS and CCTP infrastructure. External wallets sign blockchain transactions; jobs track preparation, delivery and finality. API origin: https://bridge-api.argosbot.io . OpenAPI: https://bridge-api.argosbot.io/openapi.json . Four paid routes: /v1/lookup, /v1/lookup/direct, /v1/jobs, /v1/jobs/direct. API fees start at 0.005 USDC; network gas and forwarding charges are separate. Public listings: https://x402-list.com/services/argos-bot-cts-bridge-api and https://agentic.market/services/bridge-api-argosbot-io .
